findings.description: The caption states 10 leaves of 0.122 x 2.400 x 0.012 m in upvc_panel and a total of 14.1 kg. The stated area density is 12.6 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 37 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 10. Every leaf is 10x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
